name: Vera 05 · 07 Open items after the visit

parameters.content:
## Vera 05 · 07 Open items after the visit
Every morning: reminders for items due, escalation for critical items overdue. The contractor replies to the reminder with a photo; the engineer approves it from the photo, not another visit.

Generated from `n8n/mobilise/workflows.mjs`. Edit there and rebuild; edits made here are overwritten on the next import.
Each node's note says what it does and which guardrails it carries.

nodes.name: Items due or overdue

parameters.query:
select oi.id, oi.mobilisation_id, json_build_object('id', oi.id, 'line', oi.line_code, 'severity', oi.severity, 'text', oi.text, 'finding', oi.finding, 'due_on', oi.due_on::text) as item,
  mo.project, current_date::text as today,
  (select id from contacts where mobilisation_id = oi.mobilisation_id and role = 'contractor' limit 1) as contact_id,
  (select language from contacts where mobilisation_id = oi.mobilisation_id and role = 'contractor' limit 1) as lang,
  (select id from contacts where mobilisation_id = oi.mobilisation_id and role = 'project_head' limit 1) as head_contact_id
from open_items oi join mobilisations mo on mo.id = oi.mobilisation_id where oi.status = 'open' and oi.due_on <= current_date;

nodes.notes:
Only items that are due.
Guardrails: retry

nodes.notes: Sent as a message they can reply to: the reply binds to this item for sure.

nodes.name: Escalate?
nodes.notes: Only critical items, only when overdue.
